_comment: MS-02 pg-gate default config. Copy to pg-gate.local.json and edit, or override per key with PGGATE_<KEY> env vars (dots -> underscores, e.g. PGGATE_PG_HOST). BLACK-BOX GUARD: faces other than 'static' refuse to run unless PG_GATE_ENDPOINT (env) or gate.endpoint (here) is explicitly set - acknowledge the isolation endpoints you are allowed to touch (e.g. 'iso-pg:15433 + iso-tidb:4000'). Connection guidance: use a DEDICATED role/database for the gate (MS-01 lesson) - never the postgres superuser; the PG role additionally needs REPLICATION privilege (CDC face). NAMING: PostgreSQL RESERVES the pg_ prefix for BOTH role and schema names - the default role/schema are therefore 'pggate' (only the database may be pg_gate). Fixture tables are pggate_*-prefixed and the fixture schema is dropped/recreated (DROP IF EXISTS semantics) on every run.
